source.notes: links: each revolute joint's origin (xyz m -> mm, rpy rad -> deg) and axis in so101_new_calib.urdf, shoulder_pan to wrist_roll; tip_mm is gripper_frame_joint's origin (the tool point). Angle: the URDF's zero is LeRobot's new calibration, every joint at the middle of its range (raw 2048); zero_deg maps this channel's home onto it, (home - 2048) x 360/4096, and sign +1 assumes each servo counts the way its URDF axis turns. Placement: base_link is registered on model.glb by the base's footprint (base_so101_v2.stl at its URDF visual origin, 111 x 86.6 mm, the same outline as the model's lowest 2 mm): its centre (21.0, 0, -2.4) mm in base_link lands on the model footprint's centre (0, 77.2, 0) mm, base_link +x toward the model's front (-Y) with the Waveshare plate behind. Nothing here is measured on an arm: calibration, servo directions and placement are unverified.

source.publisher: TheRobotStudio (SO-ARM100 repository; MJCF and URDF generated by onshape-to-robot)
source.notes: joints: range from the MJCF joint, kp, kv and forcerange from its position actuator (the sts3215 class: gains the MJCF says were derived for a servo proportional gain of 16, not measured), damping, friction loss and armature from that class, max velocity from the URDF limit; links: MJCF inertial of the body after each joint and the gripper's moving jaw (mass kg, centre of mass and inertia in that body's frame), its collision meshes as convex pieces (CoACD {'threshold': 0.05, 'max_convex_hull': 8, 'seed': 0}, each at most 24 of its hull's vertices, farthest first); gripper: the URDF gripper joint; closed is the end of its range where the moving jaw comes nearest the tool point (derived from these meshes). Nothing here is measured on an arm.
